mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for three consecutive months signals labor market weakness that triggers equity sell-offs due to reduced consumer spending capacity, producing negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns through sustained corporate revenue expansion.
failure_condition: The joint increase in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) rising above 100.0 in early-cycle recovery indicates manufacturing expansion, correlating with positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through increased corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion, INDPRO above 100.0 fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption (RSAFS) exceeding its 12-month moving average signals sustained consumer spending growth, driving positive S&P 500 5-day forward returns through immediate revenue acceleration.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 12-month moving average is associated with negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressure that triggers central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns through higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and rise in payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates labor market tightening, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through wage growth and consumption expansion.
failure_condition: The joint decline in UNRATE and rise in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate below 7.0% in late-cycle phase signals labor market exhaustion, triggering negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns through reduced consumer spending elasticity.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 7.0% in late-cycle.
